meta.title: santo.berlin — Digital infrastructure, from one source
meta.description: santo.berlin plans and builds online shops, networks and digital systems for small and mid-sized companies in Berlin. One team, one point of contact.

hero.title: Digital infrastructure that just works.
hero.description: We plan, build and maintain online shops, networks and digital systems for companies in Berlin. One team, one point of contact, short paths.

brands.title: For two services, we run dedicated sites.
brands.description: Online shops and networks each deserve a closer look. So we bundle that know-how on two domains of our own — same team, same standard as here on santo.berlin.

shopware.name: shopware.berlin
shopware.description: Shopware online shops with Pickware integration for inventory, shipping and accounting in one system. A four-step process from consultation to support — shops that actually sell.

unifi.name: unifi.berlin
unifi.description: Certified Ubiquiti partner in Berlin: planning and installing Wi-Fi, video surveillance, access control, telephony and digital signage, all from one team.

services.title: What we build and maintain.
services.description: From first idea to day-to-day operation — we cover the full stack of digital infrastructure.

items.title: Web development & e-commerce
items.description: Shopware-based online shops, relaunches and ongoing custom development. Specialised through shopware.berlin.

items.title: Networks & IT infrastructure
items.description: Planning and installation of Wi-Fi, cameras and access control on Ubiquiti hardware. Specialised through unifi.berlin.

items.title: Systems & integrations
items.description: Pickware, ERP and API integrations that reliably connect inventory, shop and warehouse.

items.title: Consulting & digital strategy
items.description: An independent read on which systems are actually needed — before anything gets bought.

items.title: Maintenance & support
items.description: Ongoing care, updates and one dedicated contact when something needs fixing.

items.title: Migration & relaunch
items.description: Clean migration of existing shops and systems, without data loss and without downtime.

process.title: Four steps, no surprises.
process.description: A transparent process from first consultation to ongoing support.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We listen, understand the need and check what's technically sensible.

steps.title: Concept
steps.description: A clear plan with scope, timeline and cost — before anything gets built.

steps.title: Delivery

steps.title: Support

about.title: A small team that's actually local.
about.description: santo.berlin is the digital agency of Adsett & Heilmann GbR, based in Berlin Friedrichshain. We deliberately work with a small, tight-knit team — that keeps paths short and responsibility clear. Whoever advises you at the start is still reachable for day-to-day operation later.
points: One team for consulting, delivery and support
Specialisation over generalism — via unifi.berlin and shopware.berlin

contact.description: Whether it's an online shop, a network, or both — tell us briefly what it's about. We reply within one business day.
